app.title: Epic Calendar
app.subtitle: Logarithmic timeline – from the Big Bang to today

detailPrompt.title: How much detail would you like to see?
detailPrompt.message: Choose your preferred detail level. You can change this anytime in Settings.

learning.sectionHint: Guided tours – one stop at a time through history
learning.exitHint: Ends the learning journey and returns to the free timeline
learning.doneMessage: You have visited every stop on this learning journey.

grosse-reise.label: The Great Journey
grosse-reise.description: From the Big Bang to the World Wide Web – the key milestones of history in one run.

beruehmte-geschichten.label: Famous Stories
beruehmte-geschichten.description: From “Do not disturb my circles!” to Newton's apple – anecdotes retold for centuries.

erfindungen.label: Inventions That Changed Everything
erfindungen.description: From the wheel through the printing press to the internet – ideas that rebuilt the world.

entdecker.label: Explorers and seafarers
entdecker.description: From Polynesian navigators to the Panama Canal – voyages that redrew the map.

aegypten.label: Ancient Egypt
aegypten.description: From Narmer and the pyramids to Cleopatra – three millennia along the Nile.

amerika-hochkulturen.label: Great civilizations of the Americas
amerika-hochkulturen.description: From Caral through the Maya and Aztecs to the Inca – and their end under Spanish conquest.

antike-griechen-roemer.label: Greeks and Romans
antike-griechen-roemer.description: Olympic Games, democracy, Alexander and the empire – antiquity around the Mediterranean.

denker-der-antike.label: Thinkers of antiquity
denker-der-antike.description: From Thales to Epicurus – plus Buddha and Confucius: how people began to question the world.

wissenschaft-weltbild.label: How our view of the world changed
wissenschaft-weltbild.description: From Euclid through Copernicus and Newton to Einstein and DNA – discoveries that overturned our thinking.

medizin.label: Medicine through the ages
medizin.description: From Hippocrates to CRISPR – how people learned to understand and heal disease.

weltraum.label: Reaching for the stars
weltraum.description: From the Big Bang through Galileo’s telescope to the first photo of a black hole.

revolutionen.label: Revolutions and upheavals
revolutionen.description: From the Glorious Revolution to the fall of the Berlin Wall – when societies reinvent themselves.

maechtige-frauen.label: Powerful women and pioneers
maechtige-frauen.description: Cleopatra, Elizabeth I, Nzinga, Maria Theresa, Catherine the Great and Marie Curie.

afrikas-reiche.label: Africa’s great kingdoms
afrikas-reiche.description: From the Bantu expansion through Aksum, Mali and Benin to Mandela.

pazifik-inseln.label: The Pacific: islands and voyagers
pazifik-inseln.description: From the settlement of Australia through the Polynesians to climate change on island nations.

kriege.label: Wars that changed the world
kriege.description: From Marathon to the Cold War – battles and wars as turning points.

handel.label: Trade connects the world
handel.description: The Silk Road, Saharan caravans, the triangular trade and canals – how goods and ideas travelled.

china-dynastien.label: China’s dynasties
china-dynastien.description: From the Bronze Age through Qin, Han, Tang and Ming to the People’s Republic.

menschheit-fruehzeit.label: From hunter to city builder
menschheit-fruehzeit.description: Out of Africa, cave painting, farming and the first cities.

mittelalter.label: The Middle Ages
mittelalter.description: From the Migration Period through Charlemagne and the Crusades to the fall of Constantinople.

kunst-kultur.label: Art and culture worldwide
kunst-kultur.description: From cave painting through Baroque, ukiyo-e and Impressionism to Afrobeat and Aboriginal art.

elektrizitaet.label: Electricity and radio
elektrizitaet.description: From Franklin’s lightning rod through Faraday and Edison to the transistor.

wege-zur-freiheit.label: Paths to freedom
wege-zur-freiheit.description: From the Haitian Revolution through Gandhi and Martin Luther King to the end of apartheid.

wikinger.label: Vikings and Normans
wikinger.description: Raids, kingdoms and the discovery of America – the North on the move.

islamische-welt.label: The Islamic world
islamische-welt.description: From the rise of Islam through Baghdad and Timbuktu to the Ottoman Empire.

indien-suedostasien.label: India and Southeast Asia
indien-suedostasien.description: From the Indus civilization through Buddha, Angkor and the Mughal Empire to independence.

usa.label: The USA: from Jamestown to today
usa.description: Settlers, revolution, civil war, superpower – and the road to the Moon.

klima-umwelt.label: Climate and environment
klima-umwelt.description: From the end of the Ice Age through Krakatoa and the ozone hole to the Paris Agreement.

wiege-der-menschheit.label: Africa – cradle of humankind
wiege-der-menschheit.description: From the Laetoli footprints through Lucy to the dispersal of Homo sapiens – the beginnings of humanity in Africa.

epochNav.title: Time Journey
epochNav.subtitle: Choose an epoch to explore
epochNav.jumpHint: Shows this epoch on the timeline

voelkerwanderungen.label: Migrations & Settlement
voelkerwanderungen.description: How peoples moved, settled and mixed across the continents.

kolonialismus.label: Colonialism & Conquest
kolonialismus.description: Conquest, colonial rule and the movements that resisted it.

seefahrt.label: Seafaring & Exploration
seefahrt.description: Voyages, sea routes and the explorers who opened them up.

demokratie.label: Democracy Movements
demokratie.description: Revolutions, constitutions and the fight for self-government.

aufklaerung.label: Enlightenment & Science
aufklaerung.description: Reason, discovery and the ideas that reshaped how we think.

kalter-krieg.label: Cold War
kalter-krieg.description: The decades-long standoff between East and West.

mathematik.label: History of Mathematics
mathematik.description: From counting and geometry to the foundations of modern math.

medizin.label: History of Medicine
medizin.description: Discoveries and breakthroughs that reshaped healing and health.

physik.label: Physics & Astronomy
physik.description: Milestones in understanding matter, motion and the cosmos.

technologie.label: History of Technology
technologie.description: Inventions and tools that changed how people live and work.

pandemien.label: Pandemics
pandemien.description: Outbreaks that shaped societies — and the fight against them.

klima.label: Climate History
klima.description: How the climate has shifted, and how we came to understand it.
